SELECT s.id AS value, s.name AS label
ORDER BY s.id
SELECT tenant_id FROM salon_store WHERE id = #{storeId} AND deleted = 0

, payments AS ( SELECT p.pay_method, p.amount AS order_amount, 0::numeric AS recharge_amount, 0::numeric AS refund_amount FROM salon_order_payment p JOIN events e ON e.kind = 'ORDER' AND e.id = p.order_id AND e.tenant_id = p.tenant_id WHERE p.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT r.pay_method, 0, r.principal_amount, 0 FROM salon_recharge_order r JOIN events e ON e.kind = 'RECHARGE' AND e.id = r.id AND e.tenant_id = r.tenant_id UNION ALL SELECT p.pay_method, 0, 0, p.amount FROM salon_refund_payment p JOIN events e ON e.kind = 'REFUND' AND e.id = p.refund_id AND e.tenant_id = p.tenant_id WHERE p.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 7, 0, 0, e.point_amount FROM events e WHERE e.kind = 'REFUND' AND e.point_amount > 0 ) SELECT pay_method, SUM(order_amount) AS order_amount, SUM(recharge_amount) AS recharge_amount, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount, SUM(order_amount + recharge_amount - refund_amount) AS net_amount FROM payments GROUP BY pay_method ORDER BY pay_method

SELECT
to_char(d.day, 'YYYY-MM') AS label, to_char(d.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS label,
COUNT(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.kind = 'ORDER') AS count, COALESCE(SUM(e.amount) FILTER (WHERE e.kind = 'ORDER'), 0) AS amount, COALESCE(SUM(e.amount) FILTER (WHERE e.kind = 'REFUND'), 0) AS refund_amount, COALESCE(SUM(e.amount) FILTER (WHERE e.kind = 'RECHARGE'), 0) AS recharge_amount FROM generate_series(
date_trunc('month', CAST(#{q.startTime} AS timestamp)), date_trunc('month', CAST(#{q.endTime} AS timestamp) - interval '1 day'), interval '1 month'
CAST(#{q.startTime} AS timestamp), CAST(#{q.endTime} AS timestamp) - interval '1 day', interval '1 day'
) d(day) LEFT JOIN events e ON e.event_time >= d.day AND e.event_time < d.day +
interval '1 month' interval '1 day'
GROUP BY d.day ORDER BY d.day

SELECT i.item_id AS entity_id, i.tenant_id, i.item_name AS label, SUM(i.quantity) AS count, SUM(i.subtotal) AS amount, 0::numeric AS refund_amount, 0::numeric AS recharge_amount FROM salon_order_item i JOIN events e ON e.kind = 'ORDER' AND e.id = i.order_id AND e.tenant_id = i.tenant_id WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.item_type = #{type} GROUP BY i.tenant_id, i.item_id, i.item_name ORDER BY amount DESC, i.item_id LIMIT 20

SELECT e.member_id AS entity_id, e.tenant_id, COALESCE(m.name, '已删除会员') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(e.amount) AS amount, 0::numeric AS refund_amount, 0::numeric AS recharge_amount FROM events e LEFT JOIN salon_member m ON m.id = e.member_id AND m.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE e.kind = 'ORDER' AND e.member_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.tenant_id, e.member_id, m.name ORDER BY amount DESC, e.member_id LIMIT 20

SELECT d.id, d.tenant_id, d.store_id, s.name AS store_name, d.business_date, d.create_by, u.nickname AS operator_name, d.create_time, d.remark FROM salon_daily_settlement d JOIN salon_store s ON s.id = d.store_id AND s.tenant_id = d.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = d.create_by AND u.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE d.id = #{id} AND d.deleted = 0
